title: UUID Clone Collisions
description: Metadata-integrity check — native FileMaker UUIDs that exist in more than one file of the solution (cloned files, copy/paste between clones). Invisible inside FileMaker, but they disturb developer tooling that assumes UUID uniqueness.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Cloned files carry the clone's UUIDs, so the same UUID identifies different objects in different files. The solution runs fine, but DDR tools, fmIDE, diff/merge tooling and any UUID-keyed integration can pick the wrong object.
rule.remediation: No automatic fix exists. Claris' repair mode assigns entirely new UUIDs and breaks every external UUID reference. Document the collisions and make UUID-based tooling file-aware; treat the pair (UUID, file) as the object identity.
